notes.title: Release date delayed but it will be a short delay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We were supposed to released Rogue's Choice today but during our final test this week we encountered some nasty bugs that we want to fix before pushing the game!

We plan to release the game [b]next week[/b] and will keep you update on Twitter/Discord/Steam when everything is ready.

- https://twitter.com/coldcoffeegames
- http://discord.gg/mGDe5Sy

If you didn't, add the game to your wishlist to receive an email from Steam when we push the Release button. We apologize again for this unexpected delay.
Ben from Cold Coffee Studio.
